mapper.select: SELECT c.id,o.id order_id,o.order_no,c.factory_id, (SELECT MIN(s.factory_name_snapshot) FROM checkout_batch_item_snapshot s WHERE s.checkout_batch_id=o.checkout_batch_id AND s.factory_id=o.factory_id) factory_name, c.check_status,c.check_start_at,c.warning_at,c.auto_close_at,c.claim_created,o.deposit_paid_amount_fen ORDER BY c.warning_at,c.id LIMIT #{warnings.page.pageSize} OFFSET #{warnings.page.offset}
mapper.sql: FROM order_fulfillment_risk r LEFT JOIN admin_case_relation rel ON rel.relation_type='fulfillment_risk' AND rel.relation_id=r.id AND rel.is_primary=1 LEFT JOIN admin_case c ON c.id=rel.admin_case_id AND c.case_type='fulfillment_risk'
mapper.select: SELECT o.current_due_date, o.deposit_paid_amount_fen paid_deposit_fen, r.resolved_at FROM order_fulfillment_risk r JOIN rental_order o ON o.id=r.source_rental_order_id WHERE r.id=#{riskId}
SELECT ORDER BY r.created_at DESC,r.id DESC LIMIT #{risks.page.pageSize} OFFSET #{risks.page.offset}
